title: From Natural Language Intent to Executable Control: Hierarchical Feedback-Guided LLM Planning for Multi-component Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.22441v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a convenient interface for translating natural language commands into task plans for cyber-physical systems (CPSs). However, two gaps hinder their use for real execution: generated plans may misinterpret or omit the user's intent, and even a logically plausible plan may be infeasible under component dynamics, interactions, or safety constraints. Existing LLM-based planning approaches often lack informative feedback on why a generated plan fails, providing little guidance for revising the plan accordingly. To address these challenges, we present a hierarchical feedback framework that uses different types of feedback information to guide LLMs in generating executable plans for CPSs. translated_title: 从自然语言意图到可执行控制：面向多组件信息物理系统的分层反馈引导LLM规划
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）为将自然语言命令转换为信息物理系统（CPS）的任务计划提供了便捷的接口。然而，两个差距阻碍了它们在实际执行中的应用：生成的计划可能误解或遗漏用户的意图，而且即使逻辑上合理的计划，在组件动力学、交互或安全约束下也可能不可行。现有的基于LLM的规划方法通常缺乏关于生成计划为何失败的有信息量的反馈，对如何相应地修改计划几乎没有指导作用。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了一个分层反馈框架，该框架使用不同类型的反馈信息来引导LLM为CPS生成可执行的计划。我们提示LLM同时生成结构化的任务计划和相应的信号时序逻辑（STL）约束，并设计了一个可靠的算法来识别二者之间确定的矛盾，并为修改计划提供反馈……
tldr: 提出了一种分层反馈框架，通过让LLM同时生成结构化任务计划与信号时序逻辑（STL）约束，并利用可靠算法识别二者间的矛盾以提供不同类型的反馈，从而引导LLM为多组件信息物理系统生成可执行的任务计划。
en_tdlr: Proposes a hierarchical feedback framework that guides LLMs to generate executable task plans for multi-component cyber-physical systems by prompting them to produce both structured plans and signal temporal logic (STL) constraints, with a sound algorithm identifying definite contradictions between them to provide informative feedback for plan revision.
